name: The Homely Hearth, Common Room
desc1: This room is nearly filled with people laughing, talking, and
desc2: eating at the long tables. The smells of strong ale and freshly cooked
desc3: meat tantalize your nose, and your eyes boggle at the variety of races
desc4: intermingling here. To the south, you can see the stairwell leading up
desc5: to the top floors, and the common room continues to the east. You can
desc6: leave the Homely Hearth through its doors to the north and west.
